gold: Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with coagulation deficiency

selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of progressive skin laxity, yellowish coalesced papules, and excessive calcification of elastic fiber fragments are strongly supported by the evidence, particularly the histopathology results showing excessive calcification of elastic fiber fragments scattered in the reticular dermis.

rejected.label: GGCX deficiency
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence supporting this diagnosis, despite the genetic findings.

rejected.label: GGCX-related disorder
rejected.why: While the patient has a compound heterozygous sequence variation in the GGCX gene, the clinical presentation and histopathology results more strongly support Pseudoxanthoma elasticum.
